scope: synthetic frames; fixed analysis fixture; actual Qt/alignment/acceptance/JPEG; not camera or algorithm acceptance

metrics_schema.percentiles: Linear interpolation over retained samples; n=0 yields null, not zero.
metrics_schema.clock: Qt/controller use parent perf_counter. FrameHandle receipt uses the same OS counter (Microview native QPC). Worker timings use same-process durations only, with no cross-process timestamp subtraction.
metrics_schema.frame_scope: Most recent admitted source/generation and capture run; retained after stop, reset at next run. Analysis metrics span this workspace lifetime.
metrics_schema.fps: P50/P95 use instantaneous inverse intervals; frame_sampling.window_fps uses (retained_frames-1)/elapsed_span. Neither is camera sensor FPS.
limitations: No isolated Qt paint CPU measurement
Child startup and IPC overhead are combined, not individually measured
Synthetic and real-device runs require separate baseline comparison

analysis_ms.definition: Controller submission to result consumption; includes scheduling, process startup, shared memory, service, IPC and Qt polling.

alignment_ms.definition: Independent fixed-reference alignment function wall time; excludes executor queue wait.

click_to_accept_ms.definition: Candidate intent creation to ledger insertion; includes queued clicks and motion/alignment verification, excludes subsequent UI painting.

stable_wait_ms.definition: Additional automatic-analysis stable interval after global readiness and first successful independent alignment; excludes earlier field settling.

analysis_to_paint_ms.definition: Controller submission to first paint containing candidates; includes analysis and presentation delay, not isolated paint CPU time.

ingest_fps.definition: Reciprocal intervals between distinct live frames admitted by the controller, using parent perf_counter; upstream mailbox drops are not counted.

presented_fps.definition: Reciprocal intervals between distinct live frames completing Qt paint; repeated paints of one frame are excluded.

frame_age_ms.definition: First completed Qt paint minus FrameHandle.received_at on the OS performance-counter timeline. Microview uses SDK callback buffer-copy completion (QPC); other adapters use application receipt. NOT sensor exposure age.

analysis_service_total_ms.definition: Child analyze_frame total wall time, including input preparation and native analysis.

analysis_preparation_ms.definition: Child analyze_frame input validation/native loading/pixel preparation before native invocation.

analysis_processing_ms.definition: Service total minus preparation; native invocation and result wrapping, not an isolated native kernel benchmark.

analysis_shared_memory_ms.definition: Parent shared-memory allocation and source-pixel copy.

analysis_budget_wait_ms.definition: Parent wait for the shared heavy-compute permit after pixel copy; excludes process startup.

analysis_process_start_call_ms.definition: Cold starts only: parent Pipe/Event/process.start call. Does not include all child imports or readiness.

analysis_dispatch_to_receive_ms.definition: Parent command-send start to reader recv completion/deserialization; includes child startup/imports, service, IPC and scheduling.

analysis_startup_transport_overhead_ms.definition: Dispatch-to-receive minus child service total: combined startup/imports, shared-memory attachment, IPC/serialization and scheduling; these components are NOT independently separated.
